properties.description: iNaturalist observations of wild plants, animals and fungi inside the City of Chicago, calendar year 2023: openly licensed (CC0, CC BY, CC BY-NC), not captive or cultivated, not location-obscured, positional accuracy 250 m or better, with an observation time. Sorted by time.
properties.license: Each observation keeps its own licence (CC0, CC BY 4.0 or CC BY-NC 4.0); attribute "iNaturalist contributors". Non-commercial use.
properties.timeNote: Timestamps are local wall-clock times; no timezone conversion.
properties.filtering: 56,043 licensed observations fetched; 43,557 kept after the wild/precise/timed/inside-city filters.
storyNotes: 43,557 wild observations of 4,823 taxa in 2023; by group: Plants (15,258), Birds (11,198), Insects (10,353), Fungi (3,762), Mammals (1,089).

Seasonality: peak month 7 (6,554), quietest month 12 (551); hourly peak at 11:00. Busiest days 2023-06-21 (667) and 2023-04-29 (641); 2023-04-28..05-01 was the City Nature Challenge weekend; the median day has 84.
Research grade 63.0%; introduced (non-native) taxa 15.7% of observations.
Most observed: Red-winged Blackbird (436), American Robin (412), Mallard (401), Canada Goose (342), Feral Pigeon (333).
Busiest community areas: Lincoln Park (5,526), Uptown (4,887), Lincoln Square (4,142).
Densest ~500 m cell centred near 41.9625N, -87.6325E holds 3,455 observations.
Observations follow observers: parks, lakefront and nature areas dominate, so counts measure observer effort as much as biodiversity.
